channel.title: CarExpert Pty Ltd - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from CarExpert Pty Ltd (carexpert.com.au)

item.title: Audi confirms RS5 plug-in hybrid, and entry-level EV
item.description: The upcoming Audi RS5 will be available as a liftback and wagon, and will be motivated by a new plug-in hybrid drivetrain.

item.title: Kia EV4 Hatch, hi-po GT still on the cards for Australia
item.description: Kia's local product boss says the door is still open for the European-made EV4 Hatch in Australia – including the 215kW GT.

item.title: 2026 Kia EV9 GT just weeks away from Australia
item.description: Kia's local product boss says orders for the 374kW EV9 GT should open by the end of March, though final price and specs are still to be confirmed.

item.title: 2026 BMW X1 and X2 updates bring PHEV and MHEV power
item.description: BMW Australia has confirmed technical upgrades and range revisions for 2026, headlined by a new X1 PHEV variant and mild-hybrid power for base SUVs.

item.title: Nissan Patrol hit with third price rise in 12 months
item.description: The Patrol has been given its third price rise in Australia since April last year, though it's not as big as last August's $5000 hike.

item.title: LDV Deliver 7 scores more kit for no extra money
item.description: Until the end of March, LDV’s entry-level commercial van is being offered with $1500 worth of extra equipment at no extra charge.

item.title: LDV D90 now one of Australia’s cheapest seven-seat SUVs
item.description: Aggressive new pricing sees the D90 off-roader become Australia's most affordable seven-seat SUV bar one model – at least for now.

item.title: Volkswagen ID. Buzz gets another round of price cuts
item.description: Volkswagen is offering drive-away deals on its electric van and people mover until the end of April, and has slashed list prices by thousands.

item.title: Axe looms over electric Porsche 718 Boxster and Cayman project – report
item.description: Porsche’s new boss is said to be considering scrapping plans for an electric Cayman and Boxster, due to delays and cost overruns.

item.title: Sexy Lexus LC and its V8 living on borrowed time, but no end date set for Australia
item.description: First the LS, now the LC – Lexus has killed another of its most luxurious passenger cars in the US, but hasn't confirmed it'll do the same here.
